entry.content: Rupinder Liddar, PhD Student supervised by Eric Belanger and Dietlind Stolle, won the Best Paper Award in Asian Pacific American Politics from the Western Political Science Association’s conference that she attended last year.

entry.title: Rupin Liddar wins the Best Paper Award in Asian Pacific American Politics at the Western Political Science Association’s conference

link.title: Rupin Liddar wins the Best Paper Award in Asian Pacific American Politics at the Western Political Science Association’s conference

entry.content: Rupin Liddar a remporté le prix du meilleur article en politique asiatique-américaine et du Pacifique lors de la conférence de la Western Political Science Association, qu’elle a fréquentée l’année dernière.
